summary: Tested MyReports routing wire-up, Profile employee portal card, Dashboard pool_wallet.total_distributed bug fix, and Community comment refresh. 13/13 new backend pytest cases PASSED (self-service /my/* endpoints + dashboard projection). Frontend: login worked, /my-reports loads with all 5 tabs (Overview, YTD, Pool, Leaves, Attendance) showing EMP-0001 data (0.1373 PRC pool, 12/12 CL, 21/21 EL), Profile 'My Employee Portal' card renders & navigates to /my-reports, Dashboard Core Team Pool Wallet now shows 'TOTAL DISTRIBUTED 2.89 PRC' (was 0 before fix), Community post list shows updated comment count (7 comments on pinned post). All 4 targeted features/bugs verified working.

minor.issue: No auth guard — user_id is trusted as a query param. Any caller can read any linked employee's profile/pool/leave/attendance by guessing uid. Acceptable for MVP but must be protected before production (add JWT requirement and assert payload.uid == user_id).

issues: Hidden top toolbar/tabs row (Payslips YTD Earnings Form 16 Attendance Leaves) has low contrast — text is very faint against gradient header. Visible only on scroll-top screenshot.

action_items: (Pre-prod) Add auth guard to /api/employees/reports/my/* — verify JWT uid == user_id query param.
(Minor) Improve contrast of top header tab strip on /my-reports page (Payslips / YTD Earnings / Form 16 / Attendance / Leaves labels are barely visible).
critical_code_review_comments: employee_reports.py is now ~1590 lines — split strongly recommended (noted in iteration 210 also).

my/* endpoints take user_id as a query param without any auth verification. This is an IDOR risk — any authenticated user can enumerate uids and read another employee's HR data. Must add JWT+authorization before launch.
Dashboard projection fix (server.py:7774) correctly added total_distributed; however the except fallback still returns total_distributed:0 — good defensive default.
CommunityPage.js handleComment now calls fetchPosts() on success — correct fix for comment-count staleness. handleDeleteComment also calls fetchPosts() — consistent behaviour.

ProfileAdvanced.js probes /api/employees/reports/my/profile on mount with 4s timeout to set isEmployee. Good UX but adds a network call on every profile page view; consider caching in localStorage by uid for faster subsequent loads.

rca_of_the_issue: All 4 reported fixes are correctly implemented and verified: (1) /my-reports route wired into App.js (lines 188, 386-387) with lazy load, (2) ProfileAdvanced.js probes /my/profile and renders card only if 200, card onClick navigates to /my-reports, (3) server.py:7774 projection now includes 'total_distributed:1' so dashboard returns actual value 2.89 instead of 0, (4) CommunityPage.js handleComment+handleDeleteComment call fetchPosts() to refresh list comment counts.
